core.navigation.merges.label: Merges
core.merges.intro: Accounts joined into one, newest first. A merge can be undone for a while after it finishes.
core.merges.by.claim: Merged when an address was confirmed, on {date}
core.merges.not-restored.one: {count} row was not put back by {handler}
core.merges.not-restored.other: {count} rows were not put back by {handler}
core.merges.undo-consequence: The two accounts part again, and everything that moved goes back to the account it came from.
core.merges.undo-started: The merge is being undone. It may take a few minutes.
core.merges.empty-description: When two accounts are joined into one, the merge shows here.
core.merge.title: Merge accounts
core.merge.intro: Join two accounts that belong to the same person. Everything of the second moves to the first, and the second's addresses sign in to the first.
core.merge.keep-help: Usually the one the person signs in with.
core.merge.into: The account to merge into it
core.merge.into-help: This account stops being used, and its name is cleared once the merge can no longer be undone.
core.merge.moves.one: {count} record will move to the account you keep.
core.merge.moves.other: {count} records will move to the account you keep.
core.merge.consequence: Both accounts become one at once. You can undo it from Merges for a while afterwards.
core.merge.done: The accounts are merged. Anything left to move moves in the background.
core.picker.type-more: Type at least three letters of a name, or a whole email address.
core.picker.failed: The search did not work. Try again in a moment.
